title: Average boundary edge fraction
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, its boundary edge fraction is the sum, over all coordinates, of the dimension-wise edge boundary fractions, divided by $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
